verdict.rationale: Bruno is offline-only with no cloud sync or account, and stores all collections as plain-text Bru files in a local folder that works with Git (bruno-docs-8, bruno-docs-9, bruno-docs-28, bruno-docs-46, bruno-docs-48). Your data never sits in a vendor silo, so leaving takes no export step, and community users confirm the human-readable, Git-committable files (bruno-comm-6, bruno-docs-14). A Postman import/export option adds a path to a competing tool (bruno-docs-7, bruno-docs-25). Missing for 10: a documented bulk 'export all' workflow, evidence that the Bru format is a standard or fully specified open format rather than Bruno-specific markup, and in-depth documentation of export targets beyond a release-note mention of Postman export.
